boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Ten map-listed destinations on Brookings corridors west of SDSU, each with a concrete stop to orient an off-campus walk.

cards.title: Children's Museum of South Dakota
cards.subtitle: 4th Street corridor — 521 4th St.
cards.notes: Walk the 4th Street corridor to this map-listed museum and use its public visitor information to plan a daytime stop.
cards.short_summary: An interactive museum destination on 4th Street.
cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Brookings' walking map lists the Children's Museum of South Dakota.
cards.access_notes: Confirm admission and exhibit access before visiting.

cards.title: Brookings Public Library
cards.subtitle: 3rd Street corridor — downtown Brookings
cards.notes: Use the 3rd Street corridor for a library stop; the downtown walking map identifies Brookings Public Library there.

cards.evidence_claim: Downtown Brookings' walking map lists Brookings Public Library.
cards.access_notes: Check the library's current hours before making the trip.
